newsitem.title: USA: Dow industrials fall more than 60 points.
newsitem.headline: Dow industrials fall more than 60 points.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average changed direction and fell more than 60 points in afternoon trading Wednesday following a downturn in the bond market. In late morning, the Dow had gained more than 50 points.

At 2:54 p.m. EDT, the index of 30 blue-chip issues was off 64.46 points at 7,693.60, which re-activated the New York Stock Exchange's limits on program trading. The 30-year Treasury fell about half a point, or $5 on a $1,000 bond, raising its yield to 6.73 percent from 6.69 percent Tuesday. The price and yield move in opposite directions.
